claims.call: The Ducks’ P1 (LaCombe and Warren) spends at least 42% of its 5-on-5 time against the Bruins’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Ducks keep sending LaCombe and Warren out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Joel Quenneville has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Bruins’ first line is Pastrňák, Zacha and Geekie.

notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 7 games cover only 31% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the fifth-lowest in the league (a typical team: 47%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Jonathan Aspirot has not dressed for the last 4 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters. Frédéric Brunet has taken his spot beside Mason Lohrei.
Charlie McAvoy returned in their last game after missing 6 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.
Troy Terry is on long-term injured reserve and has not played this season. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
Mikael Granlund is out (upper-body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is a top-six forward.

ANA.head: The Ducks start a half-step ahead
ANA.body: Even though Anaheim will be without Terry, the Ducks have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage. The Bruins can still swing it if they keep dangerous shots away.
